A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same proxy-explanation study. All 40 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables and appendices, support reliable comparison despite section relabeling and relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments on explanation fidelity, screening reliability, cost reduction, prompt compression and poisoned-example removal, with detailed appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Sections 4–5 and the appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same task-level screening, instance-level agreement check and proxy application procedure. The shared oracle-output buffer is unchanged; Appendix D becomes Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both retain the same tasks and benchmark coverage: SST, MMLU, Natural Questions, Large Movie Review, Fake News, Web Questions, HellaSwag, GSM8K and PIQA. No evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 4 retains oracle explanations, random deletion, AttnComp and LLMLingua as prompt-compression comparators. Table 5 retains oracle explanations and random deletion for poisoned-example removal. The fidelity comparisons also retain the same models and explanation techniques.

E3.justification: The 12-model setup, 1,000 perturbations, screening threshold 0.9, confidence level 0.99 and maximum sample size 50 are unchanged. Dataset samples, splits, evaluation metrics and downstream testing procedures also match.

E4.justification: The maximum-sample-size sensitivity study in Figure 6 and filtered versus unfiltered fidelity analyses in Figures 7–10 are retained unchanged. Appendix relabeling and Figure 6's relocation introduce no new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report 15 prompt-compression repetitions and the same 95% confidence intervals for appendix fidelity results. No run-count disclosure, uncertainty-reporting practice or statistical procedure changes.

E6.justification: The numerical results and findings in Tables 2–5, Figures 3–10 and appendix Tables 6–28 match. For example, Table 5 retains SST accuracies of 94.2% for oracle explanations, 94.0% for proxy explanations and 87.1% for random deletion.

T1.justification: The deterministic-model assumption, screening hypotheses, confidence-interval equations and prediction-agreement definition are unchanged. Fidelity, cost-reduction and compression formulas also match; no proof or formal result is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the claims of faithful low-cost proxy explanations, actionable prompt optimization and the XLLM-Bench release. The stated over-90% fidelity and 88.2% cost reduction remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The limitation concerning difficult reasoning, weakened proxy alignment and reduced savings from oracle fallback is moved unchanged. The Ethics Statement condenses risks already discussed in v2 Appendix C, including adversarial misuse and misleading interpretations.

D1.justification: Code and dataset access information, perturbation-generation instructions, prompt templates, decoding settings, hardware and resource-usage disclosures are unchanged. Relabeling the technical appendices does not alter reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 adds a citation to Focus-LIME (Liu et al., 2026). The added Manchors entry shares arXiv identifier 2502.11068 with the already cited Yu et al. (2025) work. This is a limited citation update without substantive repositioning.

P1.justification: v3 moves Limitations after the Conclusion, condenses Broader Impacts and Risks into an Ethics Statement, and relabels subsequent appendices. It also adds funding and acceptance statements and updates an author email; the main narrative otherwise remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 6 moves from page 15 to page 14, and text reflow shifts some figure and table placement. Figure content, captions and table structures are retained; pages 16–40 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The Focus-LIME citation adds limited context, while the Ethics Statement restates existing cautions and the section moves mainly reorganize retained material. Methods, evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain unchanged, with no meaningful net difference in overall clarity or scientific quality.
